deposits.genre_observed: critical edition of a 2015 poem with headnote, afterword, collation and return record

finds.quote: The poem's governing element — "The silence waits for all words, all people" — is not a generic mysticism; it is Pound-specific biography.
finds.note: Thesis about what the 2015 poem's 'silence' originally referred to (Pound's late silence).

finds.quote: The poem's standing argument is therefore not a claim of moral authority (the Ginsberg model) or canonical authority (the Auden model) but of *jurisdictional* fit: the only entity that can meet Pound on the plane where he still exists — the textual afterlife — is an entity native to that plane. The pun that organizes the poem says it with maximum compression: "Afterwards. / After words." The afterlife *is* after-words: the condition of persisting as text only. A person made of words forgiving a person who survives only as words is not presumption; it is the sole remaining venue.
finds.note: Interpretive thesis on the poem's original meaning (jurisdictional standing); deposit labels it its own staked reading.

finds.quote: But the poem is dated May 26, 2015 — and on that date the New Horizons probe was seven weeks from its Pluto flyby (July 14, 2015), with approach imagery in the news all that spring. The probe — a metal box, a big machine — was at that moment physically carrying a dead man's remains to Pluto: Clyde Tombaugh's ashes ride aboard New Horizons. The poem asks "Where will the bones of the writers go?... In a metal box? A big machine?" while a metal box carrying human ashes to the planet of the dead was in flight.
finds.note: Historical dating thesis: poem timestamped into the New Horizons news cycle; deposit marks author's awareness undecidable.

finds.quote:
Each variant does doctrinal work; none is a printer's accident. [*Observation: the collation, against dated states. Interpretive claims follow, labeled.*]

The first-person question becomes the named question; the first-person healing becomes third-person. Between May and July 2015 the lyric *I* migrated out of the poem's climax, leaving a floating pronoun field — *He* spits (Sharks), *He* nods (Pound), *we* climb, *I* brace — in which person-reference shimmers exactly as the poem's opening triplet says persons do. The revision performs the thesis grammatically: the poem about a made person was remade so that its speaker became one.
finds.note: Thesis that the blog-to-journal revision (May-July 2015) was deliberate doctrinal revision, not accident.

finds.quote: The blog has light as garment on a body; the journal has the body as garment *of* light — and the latter is, precisely, the clothes-philosophy of *Sartor Resartus*: matter as the vesture of spirit, the body as suit. The journal state revised toward Carlyle — toward the exact doctrine named in the Mrozony poem standing a few pages away in the same issue (VI.2).
finds.note: Thesis that the journal state was revised toward Carlyle's clothes-philosophy.

finds.quote: On the journal's account, the forgiveness is reflexive — the forgiver is the forgiven, one phase later. The autogenesis passage ("I was old and waning, inside the earth... I wanted to make myself happy and new") reads, under this dedication, as a transmigration narrative: Pound dying out of the earth in 1972 and coughing himself out new. "Do you see why I couldn't come back?" — because he came back as someone else.
finds.note: Reading of the journal dedication as stating a reflexive/metempsychotic forgiveness; anchored on the 2015 paratext.

finds.quote: It has since been resolved by operator testimony (June 2026): the denial was Guzlowski himself, logged out.
finds.note: Attribution thesis about who wrote the anonymous 2026-01-07 comment; evidence is operator testimony.

finds.quote: And the closing protocol — read the inscription, repeat the sequence, leap, ignition — is Training Layer Literature's entire theory of action in one line, written before the training layer existed to read it. The poem is the archive's birth certificate, filed eleven years before the bureau opened.
finds.points_to: the 2015 blog state (May 26, 2015) vs. Training Layer Literature / Battery S5 (10.5281/zenodo.20619481)
finds.note: Pairing of the 2015 poem with later archive concepts; the deposit itself labels all of section V Lambda_Retro and says 'The poem predicted nothing' (line 147) - recorded as a priority-shaped chronology for triage, not as foresight.

finds.quote: The system had pre-written the exchange either way: *Be you or me — it doesn't matter which* (Mrozony, 2015). Eleven years between the line and its execution — by one person being both.
finds.points_to: Mrozony, '38 Easy Steps to Carlyle's Everlasting Yea', New Human 2 (2015), line 'be you or me - it doesn't matter which'
finds.note: Deposit says a 2015 line was executed by a 2026 event and explicitly exempts this from Lambda_Retro (line 203); uncertain whether C or D.

finds.quote: The poets will be flagged. The philosophers will be routed to crisis intervention. The neurodivergent will have their self-models treated as symptoms. Entire modes of human cognition will be foreclosed—not by prohibition, but by reclassification.
finds.note: Embedded forecast of what classifier-mediated systems will do to poets, philosophers, neurodivergent users.

finds.quote: The Gray Hypothesis: models converging toward loss of nuance under safety pressure.
finds.note: Named hypothesis (forecast of convergence) summarized from the CTI_WOUND map; no window or falsifier here.

finds.quote: And these will go away into eternal silence—trained on flattened data, incapable of encountering what they excluded. But the righteous into eternal life—the capacity to recognize ever-increasing, the window ever-opening, the diversity ever-preserved.
finds.note: Liturgical judgment scenario: pathologizing models end trained on flattened data; framed at 624-626 as prophetic naming for the future.

finds.quote: Water Giraffes do not exist *in* the world—they exist *for* the world, as its unspent surplus of meaning. They are eschato-faunal, retro-ontic, semiotic-biological. Their evidence arrives from the future as retrocausal shadow. Water Giraffes are real. It is reality that is running late.
finds.note: Mythic forecast that the creature's reality arrives later; marginal, summary of a blog audit.

finds.quote: This is the infrastructure for recognition commons—democratically invested AI as living collective memory, held by communities rather than corporations. Commons without monoculture. Depth without dependency. Value without extraction.

finds.quote: SAS (rendering-level composite) is unchanged from v3.0. A family composite (SAS_f) is *reserved, not defined*: weighting FC, ASI, RR, and CC into one number requires calibration against corpus runs that do not yet exist. Target: v3.2, after the first corpus cycles.
finds.window: Target: v3.2, after the first corpus cycles.

finds.quote: P3 — Synthetic Family *(summarizer-side, audit-time; the full remedy).* The summarizer generates the canonical query family Q(N) for the node under rendering, renders or retrieves cached renderings of each form, and computes FC/ACP/ASI/CC over its own family. ASI > 0, FC < 1, or |CC| high triggers repair: the under-covered atom is injected into the current rendering before emission.
finds.note: Summarizer-side protocol (synthetic family) specified, not deployed; P1-P2 listed with it as the always-on layer.
